plain: The state of being of no use

webster.text: Uselessness; the quality of being unprofitable; unprofitableness; as the inutility of vain speculations and visionary projects.

example.quote: When they came solely to be depended on, their inutility was fully discovered.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 10, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
